% A file of the document named like glossary.4ht, in a subfolder, that
% names itself with \ProvidesFile{glossary.tex}, read in the preamble with
% the primitive \input, without braces: \input test-priminput/glossary.
% The primitive sets no \CurrentFileUsed. As in the PDF, the file's text
% is in the page.
\documentclass{article}
\input test-priminput/glossary
\begin{document}
Glossary: \primglossary
\end{document}
